Hero.subtitle: The offline-first financial OS with instant synchronization. Manage your budget solo or scale to your family using corporate-grade access roles.

Features.offlineDesc: Works instantly even in a bunker. Local SQLite database onboard ensures zero wait time.
Features.syncDesc: Once online, data automatically syncs to the cloud via Supabase Edge Functions without loss.
Features.sharedDesc: Corporate-grade access hierarchy (Owner, Editor, Viewer). Anarchy rejected. You decide who sees what.
